probe_assessment: The claude-sonnet effort-low cold read held up for the module's purpose and listed public API: the code does run four fixed cases through two parents, validates pinned inputs, extracts court evidence, performs inference, scores successful configurations, and writes terminal artefacts. Three listed stumbles are genuine comprehension traps. The module docstring refers to an undefined 'shared contract'; the setup temporarily replaces a module-level SHARED_FILES global and explains only at a high level why the first three entries are used; and an inline comment introduces 'non-sset' runs and a 'no-GT path' that have no corresponding case or branch here. The probe's uncertainty about loader internals is an appropriate signal for the second trap, not a material misreading of the module's behaviour.
